Hi Ellie / Sam –

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. We’re planning a short group demo / office-hours style slot that will cover: 1) quick product walkthrough (25m), 2) deployment & security Q&A (20m), and 3) open troubleshooting/next-step planning (15m). The goal is to accommodate multiple prospect teams across NA/EU timezones without running separate single-customer demos.

Proposal: we’ll run three rotating windows on the same day so teams can pick the slot that fits their timezone. Option slots (all PT):
- Slot A: 10:00–11:00 PT (NA-friendly)
- Slot B: 13:00–14:00 PT (crossover NA/EU)
- Slot C: 17:00–18:00 PT (EU-friendly)

Please reply with your preferred slot(s) and any hard constraints. If you’d like a private follow-up, we’ll schedule a 30-minute deep-dive separately. Attached is a seed agenda you can share with your teams (seed-agenda.pdf).

Internal note: Marissa / Ben — can you cover deployment + security sections? I’ll take the platform walkthrough. Lauren, can you join Slot B?

Thanks,
Soojin
